seo.title: ABS Builder's | Construction, Architecture & Interiors in Lumbini, Nepal
seo.description: ABS Builder's is a trusted engineering, architectural and interior design firm in Lumbini Province, Nepal. House construction, structural design, 3D architecture and turnkey interiors in Butwal, Bhairahawa, Taulihawa, Parasi and Ghorahi. Call 9857055583 for a free site visit.

hero.subheading: From the first sketch to the final handover — one accountable team for structural engineering, architectural design and turnkey interiors. Fixed-price estimates, on-site supervision, and work that is built to last.

about.title: Built on engineering discipline. Finished with design sensibility.
paragraphs: ABS Builder's is a Butwal-based construction and design firm delivering homes, commercial buildings, public infrastructure and interiors across Rupandehi, Kapilvastu, Nawalparasi and Dang.

We combine licensed structural engineers, architects and interior designers under one roof — so your drawings, budget and site work stay aligned from day one. No hand-offs between contractors, no surprises on the invoice.

faqs.q: Do you offer a free site visit and estimate?
faqs.a: Yes. We visit your plot anywhere in Rupandehi, Kapilvastu, Nawalparasi and Dang at no charge, discuss your requirements and provide an indicative estimate. A detailed BOQ follows once drawings are finalised.

faqs.q: Can you help with municipality drawing approval?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Our architects and engineers prepare the architectural and structural drawings and handle the submission and follow-up with the local municipality on your behalf.

faqs.q: How is the construction cost calculated?
faqs.a: Cost depends on built-up area, structure, finishes and site conditions. We provide a line-by-line Bill of Quantities with material specifications so you can see exactly what you are paying for — before signing.

faqs.q: How long does it take to build a house?
faqs.a: A typical two-and-a-half storey home takes 8–12 months from approval to handover. We give you a milestone schedule in the agreement and track progress weekly.

faqs.q: Do you do design-only or interior-only work?
faqs.a: Yes. You can engage us for architectural design, structural design, supervision or interiors on their own — or choose the complete turnkey package.
Payments are milestone-based and tied to verified progress on site — never large upfront sums. The schedule is written into your contract.
We provide a workmanship warranty and remain available for after-care. Details are included in your contract.
